# Instrument index

47 instruments at 32000 Hz. **Live** voices are linked into a ROM and synthesised on the
VR4300 (they passed `nix/faust.nix`'s no-libm, no-double and cycle-budget gates); every
instrument can be **baked** to a VADPCM `.wav64` by `mkBakedInstrument`. `ref` is the
pitch the baked asset is rendered at; `out` is the mixer channels a baked asset costs.

## Plucked strings

| instrument | ref | live | out | what it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `guitar` | 196 Hz | — | 1 | An acoustic steel-string: a plucked loop through a guitar body. |
| `harp` | 262 Hz | 500 | 1 | A gut-stringed harp: a soft pluck near the end of a long, bright string, with a soundboard. |
| `pluck` | 220 Hz | 500 | 1 | A plucked string: extended Karplus-Strong with a tuned loop. |

## Synthesisers

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `brass` | 233 Hz | — | 1 | A swelling sawtooth: the synth horn section. |
| `choir` | 196 Hz | — | 1 | A sung vowel: a glottal-ish source through three formant filters. |
| `flute` | 523 Hz | — | 1 | A sine with a thin overtone series and a layer of breath. |
| `lead` | 440 Hz | — | 1 | A monophonic saw-and-pulse lead with glide and a late vibrato. |

| `pwm_pad` | 220 Hz | — | 2 | Two pulse oscillators whose widths are moved by slow, unrelated LFOs, through a lowpass and a chorus: the late-'70s string-machine pad. |
| `strings` | 220 Hz | — | 2 | A string-section pad: three detuned saws, two ensemble delays and a slow bow. |
| `supersaw` | 220 Hz | — | 1 | Five detuned band-limited sawtooth oscillators through a lowpass that opens with the envelope: the trance/pop lead. |
